module: Runs the vehicle and trailer delivery tasks accepted in career. Each offer becomes a taskData with a series of steps (coupleTrailer or enterVehicle, bringToDestination, confirmDropOff), an active step index and a GPS path (core_groundMarkers). onUpdate advances the steps according to position and couplings, handles the end of a delivery (vehicle removal, task removal), abandonment (fine) and computes the detailed rewards (damage, detours, delays, loaner organization, branch level, parking precision).
notes: Steps generated by expandTasks: trailerDropOff = coupleTrailer, bringToDestination (backOn='unCouple'), confirmDropOff; vehicleDropOff = enterVehicle, bringToDestination (backOn='exitVehicle'), confirmDropOff.
Probable bug: expandTasks writes backOn = 'unCouple' (capital C) whereas processActiveTask tests 'uncouple': going back a step on uncoupling a trailer never triggers.

The putIntoParkingSpot step is handled by processActiveTask (checkParking, forwardOn 'unCouple'/'exitVehicle') and by tasklist, but expandTasks never generates it in this version. Here too forwardOn is compared with 'unCouple' whereas tasklist tests 'uncouple'.
Arrival-at-destination threshold: 20 m (squared distance 400) between the vehicle and the parking spot.

Rewards: >= 25% broken parts = money lost entirely and reputation x-2; beyond the broken parts threshold (valueCalculator) = linear reduction; otherwise +5% money. "No detour" bonus (distance < 1.2x the original distance) and "no delay" bonus (time < distance/12 + 30 s): +15% money + 10, +12.5% reputation, only if no excess broken parts.
The parking precision bonuses are computed a second time here (instead of precisionParking.calculateVehiclePrecisionParking) and the logistics bonus is based on originalRewards['logistics'].
The onCouplerAttached/onCouplerDetached handlers are in a commented block: they are not exported.
navigateToTask changes the GPS path: only one destination is followed at a time (the last task added).

onCareerActivated.desc: Hook called on career activation: stores the delivery extensions and util_stepHandler.

addVehicleTask.desc: Creates an offer's taskData (steps according to the offer type, active index 1, start timestamp), adds it to the list, updates the tasklist and starts navigation to the first step.

onTrailerAttached.desc: Hook called when a trailer is coupled: updates the loaner organizations of each vehicle task.

getVehicleDataWithRewardsSummary.desc: Prepares the reward data of the vehicles ready to be dropped off (confirmDropOff step) for the drop-off screen: reads the broken parts and odometer, computes originalRewards/breakdown/adjustedRewards, then calls progress.openDropOffScreenGatheringComplete. Returns the formatted list (finished becomes true later).

returns.desc: List of offers formatted for the UI.

canDropOffCargoAtPsPath.desc: Counts the vehicles and trailers whose active step is confirmDropOff at this parking spot.

finishTasks.desc: Finishes the tasks of the given offers: stores the drop-off spot, reads broken parts and odometer, computes the rewards, then marks finished. The vehicle is removed and the task deleted at a later update (processFinished).

returns.desc: List of the taskData concerned (finished updated asynchronously).

getFineForAbandon.desc: Computes the abandonment fine: -(offer's money) x the delivery's penalty factor, and the organization's reputation penalty (event discardDeliveryVehicle).

returns.desc: Amounts to add (negative): money and possibly <org>Reputation.

getFineForAbandonAllVehicleTasks.desc: Sum of the abandonment fines of all vehicle tasks.

abandonAllVehicleTasks.desc: Removes the vehicles of all tasks (the player goes back on foot if in one of them) and clears the list, without applying a fine.

getTargetDestinationsForActiveTasks.desc: Lists the destinations of all steps of all tasks.

isVehicleDeliveryVehicle.desc: Indicates whether this vehicle is the vehicle of a delivery task in progress.

giveBackDeliveryVehicle.desc: Marks the vehicle's task as given back (giveBack); processGiveBack will remove the vehicle, apply the fine and show a message.

getVehicleTasks.desc: Returns the list (reference) of the vehicle tasks in progress.

getVehicleTaskForOffer.desc: Looks up the task corresponding to an offer.

navigateToNextTask.desc: Restarts the GPS path to the active step of the last task in the list.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: advances or goes back through the steps according to position, coupling and the controlled vehicle, processes the finished and given-back tasks, removes finished tasks, leaves delivery mode if needed and updates navigation.

drawDebugMenu.desc: "Trailer Tasks Debug" ImGui debug window that displays vehicleTasks with dumps.
